title: Which sentence contains a dangling modifier?
description: Which sentence contains a dangling modifier?
question: Which sentence contains a dangling modifier?
options: Walking to school, the rain started.
While walking to school, I got wet in the rain.
Walking to school, she got wet in the rain.
She was walking to school when it rained.

optionsMap.A: Walking to school, the rain started.
